target_customer: Pharma and biotech companies developing long-acting injectable and other complex drug formulations
problem: Developing long-acting injectable formulations takes years of manual trial and error; Persist claims robotics and AI cut about 5 years to about 2.
business_model: Fee-for-service formulation development plus cloud lab access, AI software and custom automation
product_category: AI and robotics for pharmaceutical formulation

founders.name: Karthik Raman
prior_employers: Zymergen (automation team, robotic factory for synthetic biology)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was motivated by his mother's brain cancer treatment. Education not found.

founders.name: Christopher Shelner
founders.background_notes: Calls himself a career program manager and first time founder on the YC page. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines robotics, formulation chemistry and machine learning, with data that must be generated physically in a wet lab.

defensibility.rationale: A physical robotic lab and a growing formulation dataset are slow and capital intensive to replicate, and pharma customers validate through lengthy projects.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Persist; Eli Lilly and Purdue Ventures invested in 2025.

market_need_then: Pharma wanted faster development of long-acting injectables for chronic disease; the company cites a roughly 5 year development timeline as the pain.

branding.domain_note: Originally persist-ai.com, which now redirects to persist.ai (seen in 2026); purchase details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and results oriented, citing formulation case studies

rebrands.why: Domain redirect only; no source on reasons

brand_strength.rationale: The name evokes durability of long-acting drugs, but search results mostly confuse it with other Persist or Persistent companies and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Developing its own long-acting injectable formulations
pivots.to: Cloud lab, AI suite and fee-for-service formulation platform for pharma customers
pivots.why: Company launched a cloud lab with the Series A; reasons beyond that not stated

outcome_analysis: Persist raised a $4M seed after YC and a $12M Series A in May 2025 with Eli Lilly and Purdue Ventures participating, and says it serves multiple top 10 pharma clients. Its wet lab and generated data form a real moat, though customer names and revenue are not public. It remains active with 2026 partnership news.
notes: Seed date is only known as after YC in 2023; the PRNewswire release could not be fetched (domain safety check rate limited) so the seed amount and lead rest on Pulse 2.0 and the search snippet of the release. An aggregator claims a $16M Series A led by BlackRock and Fin Capital, which conflicts with the company release and was ignored. No dated 2023 competitor source was found; the list is empty. Founder education not found.
